FROM dim_product
WHERE category ILIKE '%garden%' OR category ILIKE '%electr%' OR subcategory ILIKE '%light%'

SELECT fiscal_year, fiscal_period, fiscal_period_label, period_start_date, period_end_date, weeks_in_period, fully_loaded,
 (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM fact_sales_line WHERE sale_date BETWEEN period_start_date AND period_end_date) AS sales_lines,
 (SELECT COUNT(*) - COUNT(DISTINCT sales_line_id) FROM fact_sales_line WHERE sale_date BETWEEN period_start_date AND period_end_date) AS dup_sales_ids,
 (SELECT COUNT(*) - COUNT(DISTINCT return_line_id) FROM fact_return_line WHERE return_date BETWEEN period_start_date AND period_end_date) AS dup_ret_ids
FROM ref_fiscal_calendar WHERE fiscal_year = 'FY2024/25' AND fiscal_period >= 6 ORDER BY fiscal_period

WITH web_dispatch AS (
    SELECT web_order_id,
           CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS dispatch_date
    FROM fact_web_order
    WHERE status IN ('delivered', 'collected')
),
net_lines AS (
    SELECT CASE WHEN s.store_id = 900 THEN w.dispatch_date ELSE f.sale_date END AS business_date,
           p.category AS category_as_was, p.sku, p.subcategory, f.net_amount AS net_sales, (s.store_id = 900 AND w.dispatch_date IS NULL) AS web_undispatched
    FROM fact_sales_line f
    JOIN dim_store s   ON s.store_key = f.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
    LEFT JOIN web_dispatch w ON w.web_order_id = f.receipt_id
    WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
    UNION ALL
    SELECT r.return_date, p.category, p.sku, p.subcategory, -r.refund_net, FALSE
    FROM fact_return_line r
    JOIN dim_store s   ON s.store_key = r.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = r.product_key
    WHERE s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
)
SELECT d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_period,
  SUM(CASE WHEN NOT web_undispatched AND category_as_was='Garden' THEN net_sales END) AS garden_as_was,
  SUM(CASE WHEN web_undispatched AND category_as_was='Garden' THEN net_sales END) AS garden_web_undispatched,
  SUM(CASE WHEN NOT web_undispatched AND category_as_was='Garden' AND subcategory='Outdoor Lighting' THEN net_sales END) AS of_which_outdoor_lighting
FROM net_lines n JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = n.business_date
WHERE d.fiscal_year='FY2024/25' AND d.fiscal_period BETWEEN 7 AND 12
GROUP BY 1,2 ORDER BY 2

SELECT 'sales' AS src, (f.sale_date BETWEEN p.valid_from AND p.valid_to) AS in_validity, p.category = 'Garden' AS fact_garden,
   (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM dim_product q WHERE q.sku=p.sku AND f.sale_date BETWEEN q.valid_from AND q.valid_to AND q.category='Garden') > 0 AS dated_garden,
   COUNT(*) AS n, SUM(f.net_amount) AS net
FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key
WHERE f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-10-28' AND DATE '2025-04-27'
  AND (p.category='Garden' OR p.sku IN (SELECT sku FROM dim_product WHERE category='Garden'))
GROUP BY 2,3,4 ORDER BY 2,3,4

SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) - COUNT(DISTINCT (receipt_id, line_no)) FROM fact_sales_line WHERE sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-10-28' AND DATE '2025-04-27') AS dup_receipt_lines,
 (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM fact_sales_line WHERE sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-10-28' AND DATE '2025-04-27' AND net_amount <= 0) AS nonpositive_lines,
 (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM fact_return_line r WHERE return_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-10-28' AND DATE '2025-04-27' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM fact_sales_line f WHERE f.sales_line_id=r.sales_line_id)) AS orphan_returns,
 (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM fact_web_order WHERE status IN ('processing','cancelled') AND order_ts_utc < TIMESTAMP '2025-04-28') AS web_nondispatched_fy2425

SELECT d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_period, ROUND(SUM(n.net_sales), 2) AS garden_net_sales_as_was
FROM net_lines n
JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = n.business_date
WHERE d.fiscal_year = 'FY2024/25' AND d.fiscal_period BETWEEN 7 AND 12 AND n.category_as_was = 'Garden'
GROUP BY 1, 2
ORDER BY 2
